description: This file defines a TreeTransformer class used for transforming hierarchical data structures, including methods for setting properties, diffing, and formatting tree nodes, primarily used in trace or UI tree visualization contexts.

classes.name: TreeTransformer
classes.description: A class for transforming hierarchical tree data with diffing, formatting, and filtering capabilities.

methods.name: setOnlyProtoDump
methods.description: Sets whether to only dump protocol buffer properties.

methods.name: setIsShowDefaults
methods.description: Enables or disables showing default property values.

methods.name: setIsShowDiff
methods.description: Enables or disables diff display between tree states.

methods.name: setTransformerOptions
methods.description: Sets options for the transformer, including formatter.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the properties to be used for transformation based on current trace entry.

methods.name: setDiffProperties
methods.description: Sets the properties for diff comparison based on previous trace entry.

methods.name: getOriginalFlickerItem
methods.description: Retrieves the original flicker item matching a stable ID.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Performs the transformation of the tree data into a displayable format.
